proposal.title: Sample Layout Preview

clientInfo.projectSite: master bath tear out and rebuild

items.text: 1/2 in. cement backer board on all wet walls, taped and sealed
Porcelain floor tile, 12 x 24, laid straight with 1/8 in. grout joints
Custom vanity cabinet, 36 in., with quartz top and undermount sink
Semi-gloss paint, two finish coats on all walls and trim
Remove existing tub, vanity, toilet and floor tile
Haul off all debris and protect the flooring to the rest of the house
Cap and plug all plumbing and electrical at the tear out
Rebuild the tub surround and frame the new shower base
Install the new vanity, mirror frame and door casing
Set the new interior door and hardware
Rough in and set the new shower valve and trim
New toilet, supply lines and shut off valves
Move the sink drain and vent as needed
New GFCI receptacles at the vanity and above the counter
Relocate the vanity light box and install the new fixture
Add an exhaust fan on a timer switch

categories.name: Allowances figured in price of job to be adjusted upon selection

items.text: $1,200.00 allowance - plumbing fixtures and trim
$900.00 allowance - tile and setting materials
$600.00 allowance - vanity light and mirror
Paint colours and finish selections
Towel bars, hooks and accessories
Shower curtain or glass door

legalTerms.agreementText: Payment Note: Any adjustments to the contract price are to be applied toward the final balance, unless otherwise noted with a change order. Unforeseen carpentry, electrical, plumbing, heating, and cooling will be discussed with homeowner and a change order signed. Work will be figured at time and material.
legalTerms.warrantyInfo: All work performed by the contractor comes with a state-licensed craftsmanship guarantee.

proposal.notes: Any tile or fixture over the allowance amount will be added to the final balance as a change order.
